    What does the Sundance Institute do?
    As a champion and curator of independent stories, the nonprofit Sundance Institute provides and preserves the space for artists in film and episodic storytelling to create and thrive. Robert Redford founded the Institute in 1981 to foster independence, risk-taking, and new voices in American film.

    Does Robert Redford still own Sundance Resort?
    An AI Overview is not available for this searchCan't generate an AI overview right now. Try again later.
    AI Overview
    No, Robert Redford no longer owns the Sundance Mountain Resort, having sold it in December 2020 to Broadreach Capital Partners and Cedar Capital Partners, though the sale didn't include the Sundance Institute or Film Festival. Redford had owned the Utah resort for over 50 years but decided it was time for a transition, stating the property had become a "lot of weight" to carry.
     
    Key Details:
    • Sale Date: December 2020. 
    • Buyers: Broadreach Capital Partners and Cedar Capital Partners. 
    • What was sold: The Sundance Mountain Resort, including its ski lifts, buildings, and dining venues. 
    • What wasn't sold: The Sundance Institute and its related film festival remained separate from the resort sale, though the institute continues its programs at the resort under the new ownership. 
    • Redford's Reason: He wanted a transition to new ownership that would preserve his vision for the unique place.

      Why did Robert Redford create the Sundance Institute?
      This secluded place in the mountains later became a center for the work of Sundance Institute, which was born out of Redford's desire to support independent filmmakers. “I wanted to have a sense of place, I wanted to create a sense of home, I wanted to have a sense of community,” he said.

      The Sundance Institute is a non-profit organization founded by actor Robert Redford committed to the aesthetic growth and promotion of independent artists. The institute is driven by its programs that discover and support independent filmmakers, theatre artists and composers from all over the world.
